12540-george-washington.title: George Washington
12540-george-washington.creator: William Roscoe Thayer
12540-george-washington.description: A book by William Roscoe Thayer. " A family of the name existed in Northumberland and Durham, but modern investigation points to Sulgrave, in Northamptonshire, as the English home of his stock. Here was born, probably during the reign of Charles I, his great-grandfather, John Washington, who was a sea-going man, and settled in Virginia in 1657. His eldest son, Lawrence, had three children--John, Augustine, and Mildred.

arxiv-2206-14338.title: Lagrangian 3-form structure for the Darboux system and the KP hierarchy
arxiv-2206-14338.creator: Frank W Nijhoff † † \dagger School of Mathematics, University of Leeds, Leeds LS2 9JT, UK F.W.Nijhoff@leeds.ac.uk
arxiv-2206-14338.description: Abstract A Lagrangian multiform structure is established for a generalisation of the Darboux system describing orthogonal curvilinear coordinate systems. It has been shown in the past that this system of coupled PDEs is in fact an encoding of the entire Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) hierarchy in terms so-called Miwa variables.

arxiv-2209-13642.title: Connection between Emission and Absorption Outflows through the Study of Quasars with Extremely-High Velocity Outflows astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , C iv distance ( McCaffrey & Richards 2021 )
arxiv-2209-13642.creator: Paola Rodríguez Hidalgo, Amy L. Rankine
arxiv-2209-13642.description: Abstract A recently-discovered class of outflows, extremely high-velocity outflows (EHVOs), may be key to understanding feedback processes as it is likely the most powerful in terms of mass-energy. These EHVOs have been observed at redshifts 1.052 < z em < <z_{\rm em}< 7.641, but the potential connection with outflows in emission had not been studied.

arxiv-2405-01742.title: Addressing Privacy Concerns in Joint Communication and Sensing for 6G Networks: Challenges and Prospects
arxiv-2405-01742.creator: Prajnamaya Dass (🖂), Sonika Ujjwal, Jiri Novotny, Yevhen Zolotavkin, Zakaria Laaroussi, Stefan Köpsell
arxiv-2405-01742.description: Abstract The vision for 6G extends beyond mere communication, incorporating sensing capabilities to facilitate a diverse array of novel applications and services. However, the advent of joint communication and sensing (JCAS) technology introduces concerns regarding the handling of sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) pertaining to individuals and objects, along with external third-party data and disclosure.

arxiv-2408-08766.title: VF-NeRF: Learning Neural Vector Fields for Indoor Scene Reconstruction
arxiv-2408-08766.creator: Albert Gassol Puigjaner, Edoardo Mello Rella, Erik Sandström, Ajad Chhatkuli, Luc Van Gool
arxiv-2408-08766.description: Abstract Implicit surfaces via neural radiance fields (NeRF) have shown surprising accuracy in surface reconstruction. Despite their success in reconstructing richly textured surfaces, existing methods struggle with planar regions with weak textures, which account for the majority of indoor scenes.

arxiv-2506-06006.title: Bootstrapping World Models from Dynamics Models in Multimodal Foundation Models
arxiv-2506-06006.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . To what extent do vision-and-language foundation models possess a realistic world model (observation × \times action → \rightarrow observation) and a dynamics model (observation × \times observation → \rightarrow action), when actions are expressed through language? While open-source foundation models struggle with both, we find that fine-tuning them to acquire a dynamics model through supervision is significantly easier than acquiring a world model.

pmc-11330484.creator: Chuan He, Jingzhuo Zhou, Rui Zhou, Cong Chen, Siyi Jing, Kaiyu Mu, Yu-Ting Huang, Chih-Chun Chung, Sheng-Jye Cherng, Yang Lu, King-Ning Tu, Shien-Ping Feng

pmc-11551511.title: Successful resolution of duodenal stump leakage and bile duct disconnection after gastrectomy: endotherapy salvage
pmc-11551511.creator: Federica Fimiano, Lorenzo Dioscoridi, Edoardo Forti, Francesco Pugliese, Marcello Cintolo, Giulia Bonato, Marianna Bravo, Massimiliano Mutignani
pmc-11551511.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Video

Subtotal gastrectomy can lead to severe adverse events, including duodenal stump leakage (DSL), a life-threatening issue with 3% incidence and mortality rate ranging from 7% to 67%.1,2 Generally, endotherapy is not considered the standard treatment for DSL. This case report details a successful endoscopic approach to manage DSL associated with distal common bile duct (CBD) necrosis in a 46-year-old patient after subtotal gastrectomy for a gastric antral adenocarcinoma (pT3N2). On the fifth postoperative day, the patient developed adverse events.

pmc-11699099.title: Analyzing trends and factors influencing price changes in public pooled drugs procurement system in Malaysia: Exploring market competition
pmc-11699099.creator: Farahwahida Mohd Kasim, Ernieda Hatah, Lokhman Hakim Osman, Adliah Mhd Ali, Zaheer-Ud-Din Babar
pmc-11699099.description: BackgroundPooled procurement is key to managing drug spending amid rising healthcare costs, but conclusive evidence on its sustained impact is lacking, driven by market competition.ObjectiveThis study aims to evaluate the trends and factors influencing the price changes of drugs awarded for pooled procurement systems utilizing a drug price index analysis.

pmc-12481558.title: Halogenation-Guided Chemical Screening Uncovers Cyanobacterin Analogues from the Cyanobacterium Tolypothrix sp. PCC9009
pmc-12481558.creator: Franziska Schanbacher, Arthur Guljamow, Valerie I. C. Rebhahn, Peter Schmieder, Heike Enke, Elke Dittmann, Martin Baunach, Timo H. J. Niedermeyer
pmc-12481558.description: Halogenated specialized metabolites show high chemical diversity and exhibit a range of biological activities. A targeted screening of a cyanobacteria extract library for halogenated specialized metabolites using HPLC-HRMS combined with MassQL and Haloseeker indicated that several of the extracts contained halogenated compounds, among them an extract of Tolypothrix sp. PCC9009.

pmc-12540640.title: Fluctuation Relations Associated to an Arbitrary Bijection in Path Space
pmc-12540640.creator: Raphaël Chétrite, Stefano Marcantoni
pmc-12540640.description: We introduce a framework to identify Fluctuation Relations for vector-valued observables in physical systems evolving through a stochastic dynamics. These relations arise from the particular structure of a suitable entropic functional and are induced by transformations in trajectory space that are invertible but are not involutions, typical examples being spatial rotations and translations.

pmc-12552980.title: nNOS-mediated S-nitrosylation of TCOF1 regulates KRAS proteostasis to suppress hepatoblastoma progression
pmc-12552980.creator: Meng Wang, Yupeng Wang, Yue Qian, Ziyan Luo, Siqi Dong, zhuoyan Li, Lingling Wu, Fang Yu, Zihua Lin, Lin Qiu, Hua Jiang, Linna Yu
pmc-12552980.description: Neuronal nitric oxide synthase (nNOS) plays dual roles in tumorigenesis, but its function in hepatoblastoma (HB) remains unclear. Analysis of 30 clinical HB samples reveals significant nNOS downregulation, correlating with tumor malignancy. Overexpression of nNOS inhibits HB cell proliferation and tumor growth in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-12811959.title: Cannabinoids rescue migraine symptoms caused by central CGRP administration in mice
pmc-12811959.creator: Erik Zorrilla, Thomas L. Duong, Cassandra L. Piña, Andrew F. Russo
pmc-12811959.description: Background:This study investigates the therapeutic potential of a combined dose of cannabidiol (CBD) and tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) at a 100:1 ratio (100 mg/kg CBD and 1 mg/kg THC) in mitigating central calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)-induced migraine symptoms in a mouse model.

pmc-13064561.title: The adiponectin/leptin ratio as a biomarker of adiposopathy and visceral adipose tissue accumulation: sex-specific mechanisms
pmc-13064561.creator: Aida Medina-Urrutia, Iván Torre-Villalvazo, Andrea Díaz-Villaseñor, Esteban Jorge-Galarza, Luz Graciela Cervantes-Pérez, Neftali Eduardo Antonio-Villa, Felipe Santibañez-Escobar, Gabriela Leal-Escobar, Brenda Marquina-Castillo, Froylan David Martínez-Sánchez, Juan Gabriel Juárez-Rojas
pmc-13064561.description: Adipose tissue (AT) dysfunction can lead to increased visceral AT (VAT) and metabolic damage. The adiponectin/leptin ratio (ALR) has been proposed as a biomarker of AT functionality. However, its participation in VAT accumulation and the impact of sex on these associations have not been evaluated.

pmc-13348610.title: Modelling factors associated with infant mortality in Northern Region of Ghana: survival analysis approach
pmc-13348610.creator: Zafodor Fuseini Abubakari, Alhassan Faisal, Mahama Jato Asuma
pmc-13348610.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Infant mortality remains a significant public health concern in Ghana, particularly in the Northern Region. This study investigated factors associated with infant survival using facility-based data from Kpandai Polyclinic and Tamale West Hospital. The Kaplan–Meier estimator showed no statistically significant survival differences across most categorical covariates, including child sex, maternal education, place of residence, marital status, and occupation; however, a significant difference was observed for mode of delivery.

pmc-13371126.title: SXRNSCLC-PRSP software to predict prognostic risk and survival in patients with resected T1-3N0-2M0 non-small cell lung cancer in Shanxi Province China
pmc-13371126.creator: Yunkui Zhang, Xuesong Wu, Bin Yang, Rongsheng Zhang, Bin Wang
pmc-13371126.description: ObjectiveTo develop SXRNSCLC-PRSP software which can predict the prognostic risk and survival of resected T1-3N0-2M0 (according to the 9th AJCC/UICC TNM stage of lung cancer) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients in Shanxi Province China more comprehensively, accurately and conveniently, and provide reference and help for clinicians tailoring patients’follow-up adjuvant therapy and care.

pmc-13420679.title: Structural Valve Failure During Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement
pmc-13420679.creator: Willette Valjean P Go, Victorio Luis Gabriel N Javier, Christopher Bernard DLR Javier, Saturnino P Javier, Valerie R Zarza-Geron, Timothy C Dy
pmc-13420679.description: ObjectivesInfolding, deformation, and embolization are forms of valve failure linked to significant complications. We report a successful same-procedure bailout redo-transcatheter aortic valve placement (redo-TAV) approach after failure of the index transcatheter aortic valve replacement.Key StepsAn Evolut 34-mm valve showed infolding with vertical-line sign after deployment. Postdilatation with a NuMED 25-mm balloon caused deformation, embolization, and significant aortic regurgitation.
